attestations.description: Dated public 5-year CDS levels, one value per published report, used only to decide which side of its standard coupon a name trades on when an unsigned DTCC upfront has two feasible readings. DTCC trades still set every level. A mark is used for trades executed on or after its date, for at most max_age_days calendar days, and only while it is the name's latest mark. It decides only if it sits at least decisive_factor times away from the coupon, and only for trades whose two readings are at least min_reading_ratio apart. Otherwise the trade stays ambiguous and prices nothing. Keep exactly one mark per entity and date; cite the report that states the value.

marks.reported_by: wide: keeps the high reading from 20 Nov
tight: keeps the low reading from 26 Nov, never earlier
decisive but over 21 days old on every corpus day
too near the 1% coupon to decide
